fusions.name: Brand to Thatch
fusions.desc: Looses 3 burning arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 8 fire damage and setting the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Pitch-Soaked Shaft
fusions.desc: Looses a pitch-soaked arrow at a target up to 9 tiles away that deals 30 fire damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Lit Trench
fusions.desc: Shoots a line of fire 5 tiles long into the ground ahead of you for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Ember Stave
fusions.desc: Conjures a stave of fire to draw. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
